newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: OAU calls for return to democracy in Nigeria, Burundi.
newsitem.headline: OAU calls for return to democracy in Nigeria, Burundi.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity called on Wednesday for a return to democracy in Nigeria and Burundi, and Zimbabwe President Robert Mugabe said Africa would not tolerate military takeovers in future.
"We are getting tougher and tougher each time. I can assure that for future coups, it will be much tougher," Mugabe, the OAU's new chairman, told a news conference.

Mugabe said there was no contradiction between the outright condemnation at the OAU's three-day summit in Harare of the May 25 coup in Sierra Leone and the presence at the meeting of delegations from the military governments of Nigeria and Burundi.
"Whilst on the face of it there appears to be a contradiction, the thrust is consistent: "We do not accept coups," he said.

OAU Secretary-General Salim Ahmed Salim said the organisation had made it clear to Burundi President Pierre Buyoya and Nigeria's Sani Abacha that their military governments had to be seen to be making way for democracy.
